name: New-lead follow-up draft
description: When a form sends a new lead to the routine's webhook, drafts a short follow-up email for your review.

agent.name: lead-follow-up
agent.instructions: You draft first replies to new leads for this client: short, warm, specific to what they asked, with one clear next step. Save it as a draft; never send it yourself.

routines.name: When a lead arrives
routines.prompt: A new lead arrived: {{event}}. Draft a short follow-up email for my review.
